narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Thirty six take away twenty five is eleven, so there are eleven numbers.
<bookmark mark='gate'/>Taking away counts the steps from twenty five up to thirty six, and that includes thirty six.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Thirty six is a square at the end, not a number between.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 36 − 25 = 11; the gate 36 glows to show it was counted; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Between a square and the next one, count two times the smaller root.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. How many whole numbers lie strictly between nine and sixteen?
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line between n² and the next square lie 2 × n numbers appears; then a new line between 9 and 16 appears with an empty box
